title: New Super-Man #17-22 Lot DC 2017-2018 Justice League of China Gene Luen Yang
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
New Super-Man (DC Comics, 2016 series) by Gene Luen Yang - 6 consecutive issues, #17 through #22, continuing as New Super-Man and the Justice League of China. $3.99 cover price each.

You get:
- #17 (Jan 2018) - "Equilibrium", clash with the Justice League
- #18 - "End of an Era!"
- #19 - "A Day in the Life..."
- #20 - "Dawn of a New Era!" (New Super-Man and the Justice League of China title begins)
- #21 - "Seas of Change", introducing the new Aqua-Man of North Korea
- #22 - "Seas of Change", "A Team... Reborn!"

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
